description: Water Distribution in a Socio-Technical System: Resilience Assessment for Critical Events Causing Demand Relocation is a data set deposited in TUdatalib by its authors Kevin Logan, Michaela Leštáková. The data set contains raw simulation data as well as aggregated results for the study "Water Distribution in a Socio-Technical System: Resilience Assessment for Critical Events Causing Demand Relocation" in MDPI water 2021, 13(15) (DOI: https://doi.org/10.3390/w13152062). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
